description: This dataset contains environmental measurements of Dissolved Organic Matter collected during four expeditions in 2019. It includes geospatial coordinates, timestamps, and water depth for each sampling station. The data features various chemical properties, such as IFDOM components and FDOM peaks, which characterize the composition of dissolved organic matter. Researchers can use this information to analyze spatial and temporal variations in organic matter quality. The dataset supports studies on biogeochemical cycles and water quality assessment in marine environments. By examining indices like fluorescence and humification, scientists can better understand the sources and processing of organic carbon in these ecosystems.
